record.body:
## Problem

The terminal dashboard lists an effort's phases and tasks as rows, with verification as glyphs and a matrix. Dependencies, phase grouping, and what verification is doing are hard to see. The parked ui-revamp is promoted so the surface and information structure can be settled before any tasks.

## Approach

not yet scoped — discuss in progress

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. At minimum the chosen surface shows an effort's phases and tasks, verification state, and any milestone grouping this discussion adopts, checked against a seeded store.
record.subject: ui-overhaul
